# LearnWord

> LearnWord is a multilingual vocabulary learning application designed for studying the same vocabulary across three or more languages in one learning flow. It combines vocabulary lessons, multiple translations, pronunciation audio, difficult-word review and progress tracking in a mobile-first interface.

LearnWord is intended for multilingual learners who want to keep several languages connected instead of maintaining a separate vocabulary deck for every language pair. The learning application can run as a Telegram Mini App. The public website contains product information and practical multilingual learning guides.

Canonical public website: https://learnword.iovenko.eu/
Learning application: https://learn.iovenko.eu/
Source repository: https://github.com/ViktorIovenko/Learn_English_and_Dutch

## Learning guides

- [How to learn vocabulary in three languages at the same time](https://learnword.iovenko.eu/blog/how-to-learn-vocabulary-in-three-languages/index.md): A concept-centered method for studying the same vocabulary across three or more languages.
- [How to organize multilingual vocabulary without confusion](https://learnword.iovenko.eu/blog/organize-multilingual-vocabulary/index.md): Lesson and vocabulary structure for scalable multilingual study.
- [Why a Telegram Mini App works well for vocabulary practice](https://learnword.iovenko.eu/blog/telegram-mini-app-language-learning/index.md): Mobile-first vocabulary learning, cached study data and pronunciation access.
